text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000201's 99215 share runs several times the all-provider rate in every complexity band, but the few returned charts support the billed level, so the pattern is unresolved.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The excess is not explained by panel acuity. The by-complexity table shows the 99215 share elevated about fourfold to fivefold in every stratum, including patients with zero chronic conditions, although most 99215s do fall on multi-morbid patients. Against that, all 7 documented 99215 claims were supported, and the data-reviewed-without-lab signal is minimal, which leans toward legitimate complexity. Records cover only a small share of claims, so the documentation is too thin to clear or confirm the pattern. The sampled low-complexity 99215s are the most questionable, especially Z09 follow-up or single-symptom visits such as C0103880, C0103939 and C0103348. C0104472 (single-condition hyperlipidemia, documented high MDM with no minutes recorded) also deserves a check for template or cloned notes. A reviewer should first expand the records request to target 99215s on 0–1 condition patients and compare note text across visits for templating."}
